summary: User received SMS about a transaction attempt followed by a phone call from someone impersonating Crypto.com support who knew personal details and attempted to trick the user into clicking a malicious login link to remove a fake device.
user_mistake: Answered unsolicited support call and engaged with impersonator attempting to induce link click
prevention: Do not click login links sent during unsolicited calls / Contact Crypto.com only through official app or website channels
